title: Montmorency Falls & Île d’Orléans – 4-Hour Private Driving Tour
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: As you journey through the stunning landscapes of Île d'Orléans and Montmorency Falls, prepare your taste buds for a delicious adventure. Your chauffeur-guide, curates stops at charming local producers where you’ll sample artisanal delights — from crisp apple cider and elegant vineyard selections to fresh berries and maple-infused treats. Each tasting is a chance to connect with the island’s rich agricultural heritage and meet the passionate people behind the flavors. It’s not just sightseeing — it’s a feast for the senses. Dog-friendly tour (Upon request): This is a 100% private tour, so you can bring your dog along if they are clean and well-behaved. Message me before booking.
